Hey look, brand new shiny cover page!

This gallery adds chapter 18 and beyond.

Please add tags as it fits.

We thanks the grammar nazi for helping us identify mistakes made after the release of new chapters.

Added a disclaimer page in case anyone doesn't realize to not be following Comfy Pillows Scans anymore for new releases.

UPDATED OLD ANNOUNCEMENT: We are now currently in the process of working on the 1LDK Volume tanks and splitting up this gallery. There are currently 3 volumes uploaded. The first two volumes are having the translations redone due to the sketchy early translations done by Comfy Pillows Scans. They will also have the extra chapters and pages included in the volumes translated. Certain conditions have been met to make this achievable. Please look forward to it eventually.

NEWER ANNOUNCEMENT: If you are reading this, I changed the status of my old announcement again (11/2024), to reflect our current efforts that we have been making. We're now working at a decent enough rate that us, as a group, are happy with. Our next chapter dump will be an unknown amount of chapters, continuing with chapters 58-??(release date TBD). If you want to stay current with this series, I implore you to check out our Discord server to stay up to date with our latest releases, as we post this series on a different site once we complete a chapter.

Chapter 56 starts here: https://e-hentai.org/s/c39d4082dc/3778333-1819

As always, please join us at our Discord server to stay update on our work on the latest chapter: https://discord.gg/HgkbjSH
